title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the final answer as (b).

title: Reasoning for Choice
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain how the electron energy spectrum relates to the neutrino mass.

title: Understanding of Beta Decay
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate knowledge of beta decay and its relation to neutrinos.

title: Alternative Options
description: Optional Criteria: The student may briefly discuss why options (a) and (c) are less suitable for measuring neutrino mass.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid confusion between the different methods of measuring neutrino properties.
